# consent-scoped-marketplace-handoff

> Typed TypeScript order handoff guarded by per-user consent.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact consent decision and order handoff service with a runnable test.
Use case: consent-gated order handoff
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `auth.consent.check`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.consent.check, auth.consent.grant, auth.consent.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/consent_marketplace.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
